Basic chat completion with a single user message

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.chat(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Say hello', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4', temperature: 0))
puts result.inspect

```
